thread:
Noah (Sales): FYI — signed Solstice Health today. 12mo dedicated + private eval for EHR integration. Contract signed, kickoff w/ customer next Wed. Need CS + Eng handoff for SSO, VPC peering, and a migration window. Renewal health: low risk now but upsell path after 6mo.

Maya (CSM): Awesome, congrats! Can you drop the high-level scope and any known risks? I’ll schedule the onboarding and own customer success plan.

Noah (Sales): Scope: private deployment in prod-like VPC, SSO (Okta), streaming API for note generation, and quarterly usage review. Known risks: customer requires audited HSM integration for keys (might need eng input), and they have a strict change freeze windows on 1st of month.

Liam (Solutions Eng): Pinging for the HSM bit — do we have existing KMS/HSM integration playbooks for private? If not, we should scope an engineering spike.

Jules (Platform Eng): We have KMS + K8s secrets flow for Redwood Private but HSM-backed KMS needs customer KMS endpoint and access. I can own the onboarding checklist for infra pieces.

Maya (CSM): Owners: Maya = onboarding & success plan; Liam = Okta SSO + API integration verification; Jules = infra/VPC/HSM readiness; Priya = support escalation & runbook. Noah: can you attach the signed SOW and the customer's security questionnaire?

Noah (Sales): Attached in the shared drive link: https://drive.redwood.example/solstice/sow_security_qs (customer approved redactions). Also they requested a 2-week pilot window after initial deploy.

Maya (CSM): Timeline proposal: Week 0 (this week): internal kickoff and ticket creation. Week 1: infra prep + Okta test setup. Week 2: deploy to private eval + pilot with sample data. Week 3: pilot review + go/no-go for 12mo prod.

Priya (Support): I'll create a support runbook and pager rotation for the pilot. Need expected error types and any nonstandard observability hooks. Can we get a short list?

Liam (Solutions Eng): Short list of known failure modes for this workload: 1) auth token expiry mismatch w/ Okta session duration, 2) KV cache warmup causing latency spikes on first heavy session, 3) HSM latency under 1k ops/s bursts. Observability: request traces with model_id + route, and token-level cost metrics.

Maya (CSM): Noted. I'll add those to the onboarding playbook. Also want to capture feedback loop cadence: weekly sync during pilot, then monthly QBRs. Priorities: SSO + infra first, then API scaling tests, then UX tweaks.

Noah (Sales): Renewal note: customer has a 12mo base with optional 12mo extension tied to adoption thresholds (>=75% usage of reserved tokens). Let's capture adoption metrics in the console.

Jules (Platform Eng): I'll spin up a private eval stack in staging tomorrow. Creating tickets now.

deploy-bot: Created ticket CS-4571 (Onboarding: Solstice Private Eval infra) assigned to Jules. Created ticket SE-6622 (SSO & API smoke tests) assigned to Liam.

Priya (Support): Linking runbook stub: https://confluence.redwood.example/runbooks/solstice-pilot. I'll add contact escalations and expected SLAs.

Maya (CSM): Action items and owners (confirming):
- Noah: upload final SOW + customer contacts (due: today)
- Jules: infra & HSM readiness checklist + staging deploy (due: +2 days)
- Liam: Okta test setup + API smoke tests + short test plan (due: +3 days)
- Priya: support runbook + escalation contacts (due: +3 days)
- Maya: customer kickoff invite + success plan + weekly pilot sync (due: +1 day)

Noah (Sales): Done on SOW link — emailed primary contacts (alex@solstice.com, itsec@solstice.com).

Liam (Solutions Eng): Quick config snippet for Okta SAML test we’ll use (dev values):
```
SAML_ENTITY = "https://solstice.saml"
ASSERTION_CONSUMER = "https://private.redwood/acs"
SESSION_TIMEOUT = 3600
```
Keep secrets in KMS.

Jules (Platform Eng): Note on HSM: customer uses an external PCI-compliant HSM provider. We'll need a network route and mutual TLS from their KMS endpoint. I’ll add network diagram to the ticket.

Priya (Support): Adding a pilot incident play checklist to the runbook: include steps to rotate keys, failover to regional model variants, and safe rollback.

Maya (CSM): Risk register: 1) HSM integration delays (mitigation: parallel spike, allocate Jules), 2) Customer change freeze windows (mitigation: schedule around their freeze), 3) Adoption slower than expected (mitigation: enable feature flag analytics + proactive enablement).

Noah (Sales): Heads-up — legal requested a SOC2 addendum; can someone loop in security/compliance if necessary?

Maya (CSM): I'll ping Security. @Jules @Liam please highlight any compliance blockers in your tickets.

Jules (Platform Eng): Will do. Adding a compliance checklist to CS-4571.

Priya (Support): For capture of customer feedback during pilot, I’ll spin up a short Typeform and integrate responses into the pilot doc. Plan to capture: perceived latency, hallucination count, false positives on extraction.

Maya (CSM): Great. OK — next steps: internal kickoff 10am PT tomorrow in #customer-success (I'll send calendar invite). Weekly sync cadence during pilot. If anything blocks, post here and flag with :rotating_light:.

Noah (Sales): Thanks team — leaving the room to you.

Maya (CSM): Thanks Noah. Everyone please update your tickets with ETA and blockers.

Liam (Solutions Eng): ETA posted on SE-6622: initial Okta smoke tests by +48h.

Jules (Platform Eng): CS-4571 updated with network diagram and HSM checklist.

Priya (Support): Runbook updated and pilot form live.

Maya (CSM): last_message_note: kickoff invite sent, all owners aligned.
